excerpt: The transformed back-annotation data are listed as WCET for the entire program, functions, and basic blocks; whether an ICD-C block lies on the WCEP; worst-case execution frequency per CFG edge; feasibility of blocks and edges; I-cache misses per basic block; code size; and spill code per assembly-level basic block.
overview: The inventory identifies the exact timing and structural facts lifted from low-level analysis into source-level ICD-C. This matters because high-level transformations such as cloning and positioning can only be WCET-aware if these optimization inputs are available at their abstraction level.
title: Back-Annotation Data Inventory
